dog.description_text:
Mowgli new flyer

❤️ MOWGLI IS LOOKING FOR HIS PEOPLE! ❤️
Some puppies want toys. Some want treats. Some want to run around and play.
Mowgli wants all of that too…but what he really loves is being with his people. 🥹🐾
This sweet boy is happiest when he's part of whatever you're doing. Hanging out on the couch? He's in. Going outside? He's coming. Need a little shadow following you around the house? Mowgli has officially applied for the position. 😂❤️
🐶 3-month-old Terrier mix
❤️ Super sweet and affectionate
dog.name: Mowgli new flyer
